_readme: What each picture shows, one line per page (page 0 is the cover). Kept so any picture can be made again in the same style (save the result with site/scripts/save-image.py). Every prompt gets the shared 'style' text added at the end.
style: Realistic photograph, professional children's-book photography, soft natural light, sharp focus, vibrant natural colors, simple uncluttered composition with the subject large and clearly visible. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
